items.text:
## Why the login test failed

The test raced the **session cookie**: it read `document.cookie` before the redirect set it. Three things changed:

- The test waits for the redirect
  - then reads the cookie
  - and checks its `SameSite`
- The helper retries once
- [x] Flaky run reproduced
- [ ] CI rerun

1. Run `pnpm test login`
2. Push the branch

| File | Change | Lines |
| :--- | :--- | ---: |
| `login.test.ts` | Waits for `/home` | +3 −2 |
| `session.ts` | Retries once | +8 |

> [!WARNING]
> The old helper still runs in the e2e suite.

> It passed 50 runs in a row on CI.

```ts
await page.waitForURL("/home");
```

Fixed in #12. The retry lives in `src/session.ts`:

```rust
fn retry(n: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
    // Once more, then give up.
    if n > 1 { return Err("still failing".into()); }
    Ok(())
}
```

```bash run the suite
pnpm test login --repeat 50
```

```text Slack #eng
Login test fixed: it now waits for the redirect before reading the cookie.
```
